question: What initial practice begins the process described to the beloved goddess?
premises: The root wheel is the object of practice
inference: The process begins when one first practices the root wheel.
uncertainties: The fused token yadānyabhyasate is read as yadā + abhyasate.
The sandhi in mūlacakrantu is read as mūlacakram + tu.
plain_english: O beloved, first, when one practices the root wheel...
